prompt.zh-TW: 海風民宿年底沒有任何流動負債（{{money:vars.cl}}），流動資產 {{money:vars.ca}}。依課程 Excel 口徑，流動比率是多少？算不出來時請按「N/A」。
prompt.en: Sea Breeze Guesthouse has no current liabilities at all at year end ({{money:vars.cl}}) and current assets of {{money:vars.ca}}. Using the course Excel basis, what is the current ratio? If it cannot be calculated, press ‘N/A’.

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_c8r1t4zm}}的分母{{term:tm_c2y9b5ex}}是零，除法沒有定義，所以網站顯示 N/A（分母不存在），不顯示無限大。這不是無限大、也不是滿分，只是沒有東西可以比。
explanation.en: The denominator of the {{term:tm_c8r1t4zm}}, {{term:tm_c2y9b5ex}}, is zero, so the division is undefined: the site shows N/A (no denominator) rather than infinity. It is neither infinity nor a perfect score; there is simply nothing to compare against.
